description: the 40 × 30 × 10 block with its 5-deep pocket of pocket-floor, the floor pulled by 6: it would lie at z = -1, below the block's bottom face. The walls are extended past a face no moved face touches, so every local edge is well-formed and the result is a body whose pocket walls run through its own bottom — refused as SelfIntersects from the Full report, the model untouched (ADR-0048 §7)
